action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Consider truncating backend.out.log periodically — it is 22MB with many historical '[push] Could not deserialize key data' lines from earlier VAPID setup. Current logs are fine but log scanning by future testing agents could be misled by stale errors.

critical_code_review_comments: kiosk_create_payment in server.py (~line 4356-4410): clean conditional branching for pending vs approved title/body/data — looks correct.

sw.js notificationclick handler correctly switches on data.kind === 'payment_pending_approval' → routes to /admin/payments?filter=pending. requireInteraction + unique tag per payment_id is the right UX choice for approvals.

Payments.jsx uses both setTimeout(600ms) before scrolling AND ring removal at 2400ms — works fine but Pending list may not load within 600ms on slow connections. Consider re-attempting scroll if section not yet present.
PendingApprovalBell unregisters SW message listener correctly in cleanup; no listener leak.

rca of the issue: Original user complaint ('I get no notification when approval needed') addressed by: (a) backend now sends title='Goedkeuring nodig · CUR X,XX' + body='Door <emp_name> · <tenant> · Appt. <num>' instead of generic 'Betaling X' — clearly flagging it as needing action; (b) data.url='/admin/payments?filter=pending' so notificationclick deep-links to the right view; (c) require_approval=true triggers sticky banner (requireInteraction) so the notification doesn't auto-dismiss; (d) Payments.jsx ?filter=pending auto-scrolls + ring-highlights so admin sees pending list instantly; (e) PendingApprovalBell+Payments both listen to SW BADGE_CHANGED for instant refresh without waiting 8s/30s poll. All 5 layers verified end-to-end.
